signal: Honeywell Aerospace Spin-off Planned for Third Quarter (June 29, 2026)
story_fr: Honeywell prevoit la scission de sa division Honeywell Aerospace en societe cotee independante au troisieme trimestre 2026, desormais ciblee au 29 juin 2026, en avance sur le calendrier initial.
story_en: Honeywell plans to spin off Honeywell Aerospace into an independent publicly traded company in the third quarter of 2026, now targeted for June 29, 2026, ahead of prior expectations.

signal: Separations Progressing on Track with Spin-Off of Solstice Advanced Materials Set for October 30, 2025
story_fr: La scission de Solstice Advanced Materials a ete finalisee le 30 octobre 2025, derniere etape de la separation de Honeywell en trois societes industrielles distinctes.
story_en: The spin-off of Solstice Advanced Materials was set for October 30, 2025, a key step in separating Honeywell into three distinct industry-leading public companies.

signal: ANNOUNCES SALE OF WAREHOUSE AND WORKFLOW SOLUTIONS
story_fr: Honeywell a annonce la vente de son activite Warehouse and Workflow Solutions a American Industrial Partners, qui s'ajoute a la cession deja annoncee de Productivity Solutions and Services, les deux cloturant au second semestre 2026.
story_en: Honeywell announced an agreement to sell its Warehouse and Workflow Solutions business in an all-cash transaction to American Industrial Partners, alongside the previously announced sale of Productivity Solutions and Services.

signal: Closed $2.2 Billion Acquisition of Sundyne, Announced 1.8 Billion Acquisition of Johnson Matthey's Catalyst Technologies Business
story_fr: Honeywell a cloture l'acquisition de Sundyne pour 2,2 milliards de dollars, annonce l'achat de l'activite Catalyst Technologies de Johnson Matthey pour 1,8 milliard, et finalise la vente de son activite PPE pour 1,3 milliard.
story_en: Honeywell closed the $2.2 billion acquisition of Sundyne, announced the $1.8 billion acquisition of Johnson Matthey's Catalyst Technologies business, and completed the $1.3 billion sale of its PPE business.
